While the search results clearly displayed a snippet stating "The director of the film 'Dawn of Life' is Fernando Cort s" (citing Wikipedia), the agent incorrectly interpreted this as the definitive answer without verifying the context or checking for other potential matches (such as the 2015 TV episode directed by Mark Bridge or the 2024 film "The Life of Chuck" which appeared prominently in the results).
